custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

Bank-English.question: ১) The word "Labyrinth" means -
Bank-English.option1: Explication
Bank-English.option2: Irritable
Bank-English.option3: Maze
Bank-English.option4: Fussy
Bank-English.exp:
• The word "Labyrinth" means - Maze.

• Labyrinth (Noun):
English Meaning: A complex network of interconnected passages or paths, often designed to confuse or challenge someone to find their way out.
Bangla Meaning: একটি জটিল পথ বা করিডোরের নেটওয়ার্ক, যা সাধারণত কাউকে বিভ্রান্ত বা পথ হারাতে উৎসাহিত করে।

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Explication - ব্যাখ্যা।

খ) Irritable - সহজে রেগে যায়, উত্তেজিত/ বিরক্ত হয় এমন।

গ) Maze - জটিল রেখা বা পথের জাল; গোলকধাঁধা।

ঘ) Fussy - অস্থির; তিড়বিড়ে; খুঁতখুঁতে।

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, • The word "Labyrinth" means - Maze.

Source: Merriam & Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

Bank-English.question: ২) The students will be allowed to take the final exam _________ they have completed all the assignments.
Bank-English.option1: let alone
Bank-English.option2: as if
Bank-English.option3: though
Bank-English.option4: provided that
Bank-English.exp:
• Complete sentence: The students will be allowed to take the final exam provided that they have completed all the assignments.

• Provided/ provided that/ providing that (যদি):
- English meaning: Provided (that)… used to say what must happen or be done to make it possible for something else to happen.
- "Provided that" means "on the condition that" or "only if".
- এই শর্তে (যে); এই শর্তে (যদি) অর্থে conjunction হিসেবে providing that ব্যবহৃত হয়।

- প্রদত্ত বাক্যে বলা হয়েছে, শিক্ষার্থীরা চূড়ান্ত পরীক্ষায় বসতে পারবে যদি তারা সব অ্যাসাইনমেন্ট সম্পন্ন করে।
- তাই শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক উত্তর হবে - Provided that.

• উল্লিখিত বাকি অপশনগুলো,
ক) Let alone (চিন্তা করা/ ভাবা যায় না):
- To say nothing of: not to mention → Used to emphasize improbability.
- Example: He can't walk, let alone run.

খ) As if (যেন):
- As it would be if: that → Used to describe something unreal.
- Example: He acted as if he knew everything.

গ) Though (যদিও):
- In spite of the fact that: while → Used to show contrasts between clauses.
- Example: I could not sleep, though I was very tired.

Source: Merriam & Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

Bank-English.question: ৩) Choose the correct sentence.
Bank-English.option1: She smiled as if she heard some good news.
Bank-English.option2: She smiled as if she had heard some good news.
Bank-English.option3: She smiled as if she had hear some good news.
Bank-English.option4: She smiled as if she had hearding some good news.
Bank-English.exp:
• As if/ As though যুক্ত sentence এর পূর্বে Present Indefinite Tense থাকলে as if/as though এর পরে Past Indefinite Tense হয় এবং Be verb থাকলে সবসময় were হয়।
- Example: He talks as if he were a leader. 

• আবার, As if / As though যুক্ত sentence এর পূর্বে Past Indefinite Tense থাকলে as if/ as though এর পরে Past Perfect Tense হয়। 
- Example: The team played as though they had won the match.

• Correct sentence: She smiled as if she had heard some good news.

• উল্লিখিত বাকি অপশনগুলো,
ক) She smiled as if she heard some good news.
- ভুল। কারণ, As if / As though যুক্ত sentence এর পূর্বে Past Indefinite Tense আছে তাই এরপর Past Perfect Tense হবে।

গ) She smiled as if she had hear some good news.
- ভুল। কারণ, had এরপর verb (hear) এর Past participle (heard) হবে।

ঘ) She smiled as if she had hearding some good news.
- ভুল। কারণ, had এরপর verb (hear) এর Past participle (heard) হবে।

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-English.question: ৪) The meeting was adjourned sine die, which means -
Bank-English.option1: postponed for a fixed date
Bank-English.option2: postponed indefinitely
Bank-English.option3: cancelled immediately
Bank-English.option4: conducted urgently
Bank-English.exp:
• The meeting was adjourned sine die, which means - postponed indefinitely.

• Sine die (Adverb):
- English Meaning: (with reference to business or proceedings that have been adjourned) with no appointed date for resumption.
- Bangla Meaning: অনির্দিষ্টকালের জন্য।

• Example sentence:
- The committee postponed all discussions sine die until further notice.
- The parliament was dissolved sine die after the emergency session.

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank-English.question: ৫) (a) <u>She promised</u> (b) <u>either to help her friend</u> (c) <u>or to supporting him financially</u>. (d) No error
Bank-English.option1: a
Bank-English.option2: b
Bank-English.option3: c
Bank-English.option4: No error
Bank-English.exp:
• The required answer is - c.

• Correct answer: She promised either to help her friend or to support him financially.

• Parallelism:
- Parallelism হলো যখন কোনো বাক্যে ধারাবাহিক কিছু তথ্য দেওয়া থাকে, তখন প্রত্যেক তথ্য গঠন করার জন্য একই গঠনরূপ ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

• Parallelism এর নিয়মানুসারে,
- And, or, but, be verb ইত্যাদির আগেও যা বসে পরেও তা বসে, অর্থাৎ, সমজাতীয় parts of speech বসে।
- আবার, Both...and, Not only.... but also, Either...or, Neither...nor ইত্যাদি Correlatives এর উভয় পাশে সমজাতীয় Parts of speech বসে।
- অর্থাৎ, noun, pronoun, adjective, verb, adverb হলে সবগুলো noun, pronoun, adjective, verb, adverb হবে।
- আবার infinitive, gerund হলে সবগুলো infinitive, gerund হবে।

- প্রদত্ত বাক্যে 'Either' এরে পরে infinitive (to help) আছে তাই 'or' এর পরেও infinitive (to support) হবে।

Source: A Passage to the English Language by S. M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank-English.question: ৬) He was born ______ Mirpur ______ Dhaka.
Bank-English.option1: at, in
Bank-English.option2: in, at
Bank-English.option3: on, in
Bank-English.option4: in, on
Bank-English.exp:
• বড় স্থানের বা সময়ের পূর্বে in এবং ছোট স্থানের বা সময়ের পূর্বে at বসে।

• Correct answer: He was born at Mirpur in Dhaka.

• Note:
- সময়ের পূর্বে in ব্যবহার করলে তারপর the বসে। কিন্তু at ব্যবহার করলে the বসে না।
- Night, noon, dusk, dawn ইত্যাদি এর পূর্বে at বসে এবং morning, evening, afternoon ইত্যাদি এর পূর্বে in বসে।

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-English.question: ৭) The synonym of the word "Fabricate" is -
Bank-English.option1: Testify
Bank-English.option2: Assert
Bank-English.option3: Endeavor
Bank-English.option4: Devise
Bank-English.exp:
• Fabricate (Verb):
- English Meaning: To make up for the purpose of deception.
- Bangla Meaning: মিথ্যা কিছু উদ্ভাবন বা রচনা করা; (দলিলাদি) জাল করা।

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Testify - সাক্ষ্য দেওয়া; প্রমাণের কাজ করা।

খ) Assert - দাবি করা; দৃঢ়ভাবে ঘোষণা করা।

গ) Endeavor - প্রচেষ্টা।

ঘ) Devise - কল্পনা করা; পরিকল্পনা করা; ভেবে বের করা; উদ্ভাবন করা।

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The synonym of the word "Fabricate" is - Devise.

Source: Merriam & Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

Bank-English.question: ৮) The antonym of the word "Reclusive" is -
Bank-English.option1: Appall
Bank-English.option2: Gregarious
Bank-English.option3: Secluded
Bank-English.option4: Ascetic
Bank-English.exp:
• Reclusive (Adjective):
- English meaning: ​Living alone and avoiding other people.
- Bangla meaning: নিভৃত; নির্জনবাসী; নি:সঙ্গ।

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Appall - আতঙ্কিত করা।

খ) Gregarious - দলবদ্ধভাবে বাস করে এমন; যূথচর; সঙ্গলিপ্সু। 

গ) Secluded - বিবিক্ত; নির্জন; নিরালা; বিজন; নিভৃত।

ঘ) Ascetic - তপস্বী; তাপস; সন্ন্যাসী; কৃচ্ছ্রব্রতী।

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The antonym of the word "Reclusive" is - Gregarious.

Source: Merriam & Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

Bank-English.question: ৯) Rana said to her, "Let’s start the meeting immediately." (make it indirect)
Bank-English.option1: Rana told her that they start the meeting immediately.
Bank-English.option2: Rana suggested to her that they should start the meeting immediately.
Bank-English.option3: Rana requested her that they should start the meeting immediately.
Bank-English.option4: Rana said to her that they have started the meeting immediately.
Bank-English.exp:
• Let যুক্ত sentence এর indirect করার নিয়ম:
- Let এরপর us থাকলে indirect করার সময় reporting verb টি পরিবর্তিত হয়ে propose / suggest হয়। 
- Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসে।
- they/ we + should বসে।
- Reported Speech এর মুল verb থাকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসে।
- Reporting verb এর Subject third person হলে that এরপরে they বসে, এবং Reporting verb এর subject first person হলে that এরপরে we বসে।

• Direct speech: Rana said to her, "Let’s start the meeting immediately."
• Indirect speech: Rana suggested to her that they should start the meeting immediately.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-English.question: ১০) She said to him, "Please help me with my homework." (make it indirect)
Bank-English.option1: She told him to help her with her homework.
Bank-English.option2: She ordered him to help her with her homework.
Bank-English.option3: She commanded him to help her with her homework.
Bank-English.option4: She requested him to help her with her homework.
Bank-English.exp:
• Imperative sentence এর Direct speech কে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তর এর নিয়ম:
- Subject + request/ order/ advice/ beg/ forbid বসে।
- Object বসে।
- to + reported speech এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসবে।
- নিয়মানুযায়ী person পরিবর্তিত হবে।
- reported verb- টি অনুরোধ বুঝালে request, আদেশ বুঝালে order / command, উপদেশ বুঝালে advise, অন্যথায় tell দ্বারা পরিবর্তিত হবে।

• Direct speech: She said to him, "Please help me with my homework."
• Indirect speech: She requested him to help her with her homework.

Source- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-English.question: ১১) Choose the correct sentence.
Bank-English.option1: We had better to start cooking early to be ready on time.
Bank-English.option2: We had better started cooking early to be ready on time.
Bank-English.option3: We had better to be start cooking early to be ready on time.
Bank-English.option4: We had better start cooking early to be ready on time.
Bank-English.exp:
• Correct sentence: We had better start cooking early to be ready on time.

• Had better:
- Had better অর্থ তবুও/ বরং ভালো।
- Had better যুক্ত sentence past tense এর হলেও তা মূলত past tense নয়।
- Had better- unreal past ইহা present/ future tense এর অর্থ প্রকাশ করে।
- Had better এর পর infinitive to বসে না।
- সর্বদা verb এর base form বসে।

• Example sentences:
- You had better study hard if you want to pass the exam.
- They had better check the tickets before leaving.

Source: A Passage to the English Language. S.M. Zakir Hossain

Bank-English.question: ১২) She said, "Hurray! Our team has scored the winning goal." (make it indirect)
Bank-English.option1: She said that their team had scored the winning goal.
Bank-English.option2: She exclaimed with joy that their team had scored the winning goal.
Bank-English.option3: She exclaimed that their team has scored the winning goal.
Bank-English.option4: She shouted that their team had scored the winning goal.
Bank-English.exp:
• Exclamatory Sentence এর Direct Speech এ আনন্দ বুঝালে:
- Subject + Reporting Verb পরিবর্তিত হয়ে exclaim/ exclaimed with joy বসে। (দুঃখ বুঝালে exclaim/ exclaimed with sorrow or grief বসে।)
- Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসে।
- Reported speech এর Subject বসে।
- Reporting verb অনুযায়ী Reported speech এর verb বসবে।
- Adjective বসবে।
- বাকি অংশ (যদি থাকে)।

• Direct Speech: She said, "Hurray! Our team has scored the winning goal."
• Indirect Speech: She exclaimed with joy that their team had scored the winning goal.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-English.question: ১৩) He has said to me, "I shall go out but you will stay." (make it indirect)
Bank-English.option1: He has told me that he would go out but I shall stay.
Bank-English.option2: He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay.
Bank-English.option3: He told me that he will go out but I shall stay.
Bank-English.option4: He has told me that he would go out but I should stay.
Bank-English.exp:
• Direct Speech থাকে Indirect Speech এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Direct Speech এ Reporting Verb এর Tense যদি Present tense বা Future Tense হয় তখন Indirect Speech এ Tense এর কোন পরিবর্তন হবে না।
- Inverted Comma এর পরিবর্তে that বসে।
- Reported Speech এর Person এর পরিবর্তন হয়।

• Direct Speech: He has said to me, "I shall go out but you will stay."
• Indirect Speech: He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay.

Source: A Passage To The English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank-English.question: ১৪) Pluck me a flower. (make it passive)
Bank-English.option1: Let a flower be plucked to me.
Bank-English.option2: Let a flower be plucked by me.
Bank-English.option3: Let a flower be plucked for me.
Bank-English.option4: Let a flower be plucked at me.
Bank-English.exp:
• শুধুমাত্র মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু করা Imparetive sentence এর Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
 - Let দিয়ে Passive voice এর বাক্যটি শুরু হবে।
- Active voice এর object টি Passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- be বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- অনেক ক্ষেত্রে Active voice এর Verb এরপর Passive voice এ by ছাড়া অন্য preparation বসে। যেমন: to, at, on, with, for ইত্যাদি।
- Pluck এর সাথে preposition হিসেবে for বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active voice: Pluck me a flower. 
• Passive voice: Let a flower be plucked for me.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question: ১৫) The news shocked him. (make it passive)
Bank-English.option1: He was shocked by the news.
Bank-English.option2: He was shocked to the news.
Bank-English.option3: He is shocked to hear the news.
Bank-English.option4: He was shocked at the news.
Bank-English.exp:
• Past indefinite tense এর ক্ষেত্রে Active voice থেকে Passive Voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি Passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Subject অনুযায়ী was/ were বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- অনেক ক্ষেত্রে Active voice এর subject কে object করার সময় by ছাড়া অন্য preparation বসে। যেমন: to, at, on, with, for ইত্যাদি।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active voice: The news shocked him.
• Passive voice: He was shocked at the news.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question: ১৬) Who is knocking at the door? (make it passive)
Bank-English.option1: By whom is the door being knocked at?
Bank-English.option2: By whom is being the door knocked at?
Bank-English.option3: By whom was the door being knocked at?
Bank-English.option4: By whom is the door knocked at?
Bank-English.exp:
• Who যুক্ত Interrogative Sentence এর Active voice কে Passive voice এর রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Who এর পরিবর্তে By whom দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হবে।
- tense ও person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- অনেক সময় be/ being/ been বসাতে হয়।
- মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Question mark (?) হয়।

• Active voice: Who is knocking at the door?
• Passive voice: By whom is the door being knocked at?

Source: A Passage To The English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank-English.question: ১৭) We ought to follow the rules strictly. (Make it passive)
Bank-English.option1: The rules ought to followed strictly by us.
Bank-English.option2: The rules ought to be follow strictly by us.
Bank-English.option3: The rules are ought to be followed strictly by us.
Bank-English.option4: The rules ought to be followed strictly by us.
Bank-English.exp:
• Active voice এ Modal Auxiliary Verb থাকলে তা Passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Modal Auxiliary verb গুলো হলো: Can, Could, May, Might, Will, Would, Shall, Should, Ought to, Used to, Must ইত্যাদি।
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Active voice এর Modal verb টি বসে।
- be বসে।
- প্রদত্ত মুল verb এর past participle বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active Voice: We ought to follow the rules strictly.
• Passive voice: The rules ought to be followed strictly by us.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-English.question: ১৮) "Fear of ugliness and things that are ugly" is called -
Bank-English.option1: Cacophobia
Bank-English.option2: Thanatophobia
Bank-English.option3: Chronophobia
Bank-English.option4: Cynophobia
Bank-English.exp:
• "Fear of ugliness and things that are ugly" is called - Cacophobia.

• Cacophobia (Noun):
- English meaning: An irrational and extreme fear of ugliness.
- Bangla meaning: কুশ্রীতা বা বিশ্রী জিনিসের প্রতি অযৌক্তিক ও অতিরঞ্জিত ভয়।

• Other options:
- Thanatophobia: Fear of death.
- Bangla meaning: মৃত্যুর ভয়।

- Chronophobia: Fear of time.
- Bangla meaning: সময়ভীতি।

- Cynophobia: Fear of dogs.
- Bangla meaning: কুকুরভীতি; কুকুরের প্রতি অতিরিক্ত ভয়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank-English.question: ১৯) John made us laugh. (make it passive)
Bank-English.option1: We were made to laughed by John.
Bank-English.option2: We were made to laugh by John.
Bank-English.option3: We were made to laughing by John.
Bank-English.option4: We were made to be laughed by John.
Bank-English.exp:
• Make, See, Feel, Let, Know, heed, Bid, Dare, Watch ইত্যাদি Verb থাকলে Active Voice কে Passive Voice রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর Object টি Passive voice এর Subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- মূল verb এর Past participle form বসে।
- Make, See, Feel, Let, Know, heed, Bid, Dare, Watch ইত্যাদি Verb থাকলে Active Voice এ to উহ্য থাকে।
- কিন্তু Passive করার সময় তাদের পর to বসে এবং ২য় verb টির Present form বসে।
- তবে, Let Verb টির পরে Active ও Passive Voice এ To বসে না। 
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে। 

• Active Voice: John made us laugh.
• Passive Voice: We were made to laugh by John.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank-English.question: ২০) Choose the correct spelling.
Bank-English.option1: Assasination
Bank-English.option2: Assessination
Bank-English.option3: Asassination
Bank-English.option4: Assassination
Bank-English.exp:
• The correct spelling is 'Assassination' (Noun).

• Assassination:
- English meaning: ​The murder of an important or famous person, especially for political reasons.
- Bangla meaning: গুপ্তহত্যা।

• Example sentence: The assassination of the president shocked the entire nation.
- Bangla meaning: রাষ্ট্রপতির গুপ্তহত্যা পুরো জাতিকে স্তব্ধ করে দেয়।

Source: Accessible Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Merriam & Webster Dictionary.
